title: HTB: Garfield
caption: The path from j.arbuckle to Administrator.
description: Garfield is a Hard Windows AD box. A writable scriptPath and SYSVOL logon script give a shell as l.wilson, ForceChangePassword gives l.wilson_adm, and AddSelf into RODC Administrators leads to RBCD and SYSTEM on a Read-Only DC behind a Hyper-V switch. Its krbtgt key, an opened replication policy and a Key List request give the Administrator hash.
